idea-plugin.name: Palebloom Theme
idea-plugin.description:
Clean modern dark themes for JetBrains IDEs using the new Islands Theme style.
  • Palebloom - A faded pastel dark theme
  • Mossglade - A soft blue-green dark theme
For more information visit the website.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Recent changes:
  • Fixed theme ids so they won't reset on updates
  • Fixed Blazor support
  • Improved contrast in Mossglade
For more information visit the website.
